Technical Asset Portfolio

Well-planned pieces that come together to build a dynamic whole are kind of my jam.

Rambert, Future Streaming Celebrity

Sometimes I want to stream on Twitch but I don’t want to fuss over my hair. This Vtuber character is here to save the day! I carefully planned and drew the individual pieces for Rambert so that they could be rigged in Live2D for animation and face tracking.

You can see my WIP thread on Twitter here!

D&D Stream Interface

My friends and I entered a “Let’s stream our own D&D game!” phase in the early days of the pandemic. We had a whole lot of fun. I developed assets for a layered interface in OBS. Each character’s stats were shown whenever the spotlight was on them.

See the interface in action here!

Edmund, Idle Champion

Idle Champions of the Forgotten Realms brings some of my favorite characters from streamed D&D games to life. I wanted to figure out what my warlock might look like on their roster, so I studied the style of the game and made my very own Idle Champ from scratch using Illustrator, After Effects, and Duik Bassel.

See the WIP thread here!

The Gift of GIFs

Hades brought some much-needed joy during the lockdowns of 2020. My husband and I spent so many hours together on the couch dashing our way through Tartarus on our Switch consoles and bragging to each other about different milestones. I made a series of simple illustrated reaction gifs so I could share my love of the game and its characters.
